exposure: pregnancy status (pregnancy-related vs non-pregnancy related ovarian vein thrombosis)
cohort: The study included 74 women (mean age 31 years) diagnosed with ovarian vein thrombosis (60 pregnancy-related, 14 non-pregnancy-related) from three university hospitals between January 2000 and May 2015.
finding: Pregnancy-related ovarian vein thrombosis (OVT) is characterized by a provoked nature and a high rate of resolution after short-term (3 months) anticoagulation treatment, which was found safe with no recurrences over a median 40-month follow-up.
